qa_pairs.question: What kind of information does the "Account statistics" section of the Metrix portal provide?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Account statistics" section of the Metrix portal provides an overview of your group's resource usage.

qa_pairs.question: Into which two subsections is the "Account statistics" section divided?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Account statistics" section is divided into two subsections: CPU and GPU.
